Vercel Blob storage (replaces Emergent Object Storage)
nodes.rationale: Full migrate (no proxy-read fallback) chosen because Vercel Blob is zero-config on Vercel; replaces Emergent Object Storage as the third external dependency to retire.

nodes.label: Neon serverless Postgres (replaces MongoDB hosting)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Supabase: native Vercel integration, branching for preview deploys, serverless driver fits edge runtimes, no RLS overhead since Auth.js supersedes Supabase Auth.

nodes.label: Subdomain co-existence (v2.goalcoach.com new, app.goalcoach.com legacy)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over path prefix: no edge proxy config, cookies stay scoped under __Secure- prefix, independent deploys with DNS-flip rollback, path prefix would break OAuth callbacks and tests.

nodes.label: AI SDK typed tool() definitions (replaces [[TOOLS]] text-block)
nodes.rationale: Drops the [[TOOLS]]...[[/TOOLS]] text-block convention in favor of typed zod-validated AI SDK tool calls; keeps legacy proposal-parser.ts for one release behind LEGACY_PROPOSAL_FORMAT flag.

nodes.label: db/migrate-from-mongo.ts ETL script (one-shot Mongo to Postgres)
JWT session strategy (no per-request DB lookup)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over DB sessions: removes per-request DB latency (Drizzle adapter would require Postgres round-trip), no server-side revocation requirement, edge middleware can verify JWT without a DB driver.
